extra.final_summary:
Average bill length for Adelie penguins by island (13 Adelie rows): Biscoe 40.93 mm, Dream 38.75 mm, Torgersen 40.70 mm.

Problems found and handled:
- species had 7 dirty cells: case/space variants ("adelie", "Gentoo ", "Chinstrap ") and misspellings ("Adeile", "Gentto", "Chinstarp"). Applied one normalize_labels fix (approved) merging them into the three allowed labels. This mattered: without it, 2 Adelie rows ("adelie", "Adeile") would have been dropped from the filter.
- island: clean, only the 3 allowed labels, no variants.
- bill_length_mm: no missing values, no negatives, all within the rules range 30–60 mm.
- No exact duplicate rows.

Caveats (columns not used by this question, left untouched):
- flipper_length_mm contains one impossible negative value (-200 mm, rules say 170–235).
- body_mass_g is stored as text with thousands separators (e.g. "3,750") in 3 cells.
- sex has 2 missing values (rules say missing = unknown, so not filled).
These do not affect the bill-length averages but should be fixed before any analysis using those columns.
